stem:
Meera and her friends at school in Lucknow held a breath-holding contest during the lunch break. Which of the following statements about holding the breath and the need for oxygen is incorrect ( )
A. The air we breathe in contains oxygen, which the body needs to perform its functions
B. Holding the breath for a long time becomes difficult because the body keeps needing fresh oxygen
C. Humans can survive without oxygen for many hours, just as they can without food
D. When breathing stops, fresh oxygen is no longer taken into the lungs

options.text: The air we breathe in contains oxygen, which the body needs to perform its functions
Holding the breath for a long time becomes difficult because the body keeps needing fresh oxygen
Humans can survive without oxygen for many hours, just as they can without food
When breathing stops, fresh oxygen is no longer taken into the lungs

teacher.key_rationale: The question asks for the incorrect statement. A, B and D correctly describe why breath-holding becomes difficult and why oxygen is essential: the body needs oxygen continuously to function, so when breathing stops no fresh oxygen enters the lungs and breath-holding quickly becomes impossible. C is incorrect because humans cannot survive without oxygen for even a few minutes, unlike the much longer survival possible without food.
